text:
Marta V.: Hi all 3 submitted my resignation today. Last day will be Fri Sep 6. I need to coordinate: COBRA/benefits continuation, 401(k) rollover steps, return of laptop + keycard, transfer of two customer accounts, and a quick chat with Legal about my post-employment non-comp clause and severance expectations.
People Ops: Thanks Marta. We'll open the offboarding checklist. High level: benefits usually run through month-end of termination (coverage through 2024-09-30). COBRA packet emailed within ~14 days for US employees. We'll also route Legal on the non-comp question. Please confirm your device shipping address.
Marta V.: Shipping: 551 Cedar Ln, Apt 2, Jersey City, NJ 07302. On severance: Manager mentioned a standard severance policy for layoffs, but this is resignation 3 curious whether any separation agreement options exist. Not a layoff.
Legal - Dan: Hi Marta 3 quick note: severance for voluntary resignations is rare unless negotiated. We can discuss a separation or mutual release if there are extenuating circumstances. Non-comp is per your offer and any post-employment restrictions are jurisdiction-dependent. DM me and I'll pull your signed docs. We can set a 15-min call this week.
Priya (Manager): Marta 3 I'll take the two customer handoffs. Please add account notes in the shared handoff doc (link: https://redwood-internal/sales/handoffs/marta). Tag @Priya and @People Ops for final acceptance. Also mark any open SSO tokens you own.
Marta V.: Will add notes tonight. Also I have a scheduled client call Wed morning that I'd like to record the handoff on 3 can Priya join?
Priya (Manager): Yes I'll join Wed 9am. Please add the slide with contacts and next actions.
Sam - IT: We'll email a prepaid FedEx label to the shipping address. Please factory reset the phone, back up personal files, and remove any personal SSH keys. For keycard, drop it in the pre-paid envelope or schedule an office dropoff. We'll wipe devices on receipt. Tentative deprovision window: 
```
2024-09-06 09:00 ET - disable new device enrollments
2024-09-06 13:00 ET - revoke privileged roles
2024-09-06 23:59 ET - full account disable (email + SSO)
```
People Ops: Payroll note: final pay + accrued PTO payout will be processed on the next payroll run after termination. For 401(k) rollover, Payroll/Benefits will provide the distribution form and vendor instructions. Payroll will DM you a payout estimate once we have your final day.
Payroll: Hi Marta 3 DM us for a quick final pay + PTO/bonus eligibility calc. If you want a 401(k) distribution vs direct rollover, we can include required tax paperwork.
Marta V.: One more: I have a service account key for an internal analytics job (svc-analytics-prod). Who should I transfer it to?
Priya (Manager): Assign to @eng-ops and add @People Ops as backup owner. Also create a ticket to rotate the key after transfer.
Legal - Dan: Scheduling: Marta, can you do a 15-min call Thurs 10:30am? We'll confirm whether non-comp applies and whether any mutual release is possible. If you prefer email, send questions and we'll reply.
Marta V.: Thurs 10:30 works. Thank you.
People Ops: Action items summary: 1) Marta confirm shipping addr (done). 2) Marta add customer handoff notes + transfer svc key (Marta). 3) Priya to join client call and accept handoff (Priya). 4) Sam send return label + manage device wipe (Sam). 5) Legal to review docs and meet Thurs (Dan). 6) Payroll to calculate final pay + 401(k) rollover instructions (Payroll).
Sam - IT: Return label sent (ticket IT-12121). Pickup scheduled Fri morning. Marking keycard separate.
People Ops: We'll send COBRA packet and exit interview invite within 10 business days. Exit interview options: Tue Sep 10 or Mon Sep 9 3 which do you prefer?
Marta V.: Mon Sep 9 afternoon preferred. Thanks everyone 3 will post handoff doc by EOD tonight.
